# RepairCostMatch
> RepairCostMatch helps homeowners understand repair scope, compare planning costs, review contractor quotes and prepare better questions before hiring.

## Main tools
- https://repaircostmatch.com/foundation-repair-cost-calculator.html
- https://repaircostmatch.com/foundation-repair-quote-checker.html
- https://repaircostmatch.com/foundation-repair-quote-comparison-calculator.html
- https://repaircostmatch.com/free-foundation-repair-tools.html

## Methodology and editorial standards
- https://repaircostmatch.com/methodology.html
- https://repaircostmatch.com/editorial-policy.html
- https://repaircostmatch.com/disclosure.html

## Important limitations
RepairCostMatch provides educational planning information, not structural engineering advice, a contractor diagnosis, a guaranteed local price, or a contractor ranking.
